# file.unarchive

Extract archive files (tar, tar.gz, zip) with path traversal protection

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `creates` | string | No | - |
| `dest` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `mode` | string | No | - |
| `src` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `strip_components` | integer | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

## Events Emitted

- `archive.extracted`
